entries.speaker: Train Monitor
entries.en: The age group with the most belief in[n]the Phantom Thieves seems to be... teenagers!

entries.speaker: Train Monitor
entries.en: We've even received messages about[n]how the Phantom Thieves are all[n]students talk about these days.

entries.speaker: Businessman's Boss
entries.en: They're the only thing my daughter[n]speaks to me about. She's been glued to[n]this... Phan-Site thing.

entries.speaker: Businessman's Boss
entries.en: I thought it was just an ordinary[n]website...

entries.speaker: Businessman
entries.en: Lately they've added a polling feature to[n]ask who you'd like to see have a change[n]of heart.

entries.speaker: Businessman
entries.en: Given people's heightened expectations,[n]it's been receiving a lot of votes.

entries.speaker: Businessman's Boss
entries.en: Huh... Maybe I should go vote for our[n]company president.

entries.speaker: Businessman's Boss
entries.en: "Change his heart so he'll raise our[n]salaries!" Sounds pretty good, doesn't it?
